usage:
cfb —— Chis flash burner CLI (Rust) Usage: cfb [options] Commands: detect [--json] List connected burners select [--port P] [--clear] Pick and remember a burner disconnect Disconnect and forget the burner voltage [3v3|5v|off|auto] Remember/show the supply-voltage preference info [--port P] [--mbc] Read flash + cartridge/game info rom-info --file Parse a local ROM header offline burn --rom [--mbc] Write ROM (--mbc for GB/GBC) erase [--mbc] Erase ROM (whole-chip) dump --out [--mbc] Dump ROM to a file (--len for byte count) rtc [--mbc] Read cartridge RTC save-dump --out [--mbc] [--type T] [--len N] Dump the save save-write --file [--mbc] [--type T] Write the save save-verify --file [--mbc] [--type T] Verify the save save-erase [--mbc] [--type T] [--len N] Erase the save (fill 0xFF) save-probe [--mbc] [--no-write] Probe the save chip (model/capacity/banks/contact) profile [list|path] List/locate flash profiles (chip command-sequence config) version [--json] Show version help Show help Global options: --lang Language (remembered; default follow system) --json Emit an NDJSON event stream (for JS clients) --port

Target port; omit to use remembered/auto-detected --mbc Operate on a GB/GBC(MBC) cart (default GBA) burn options: --no-ppb --no-verify save --type: sram (default) | flash | fram (MBC: sram/fram only) When --port is omitted, the burner saved via `cfb select` is used, otherwise it is auto-detected by VID/PID (0483/0721).
op.no_rom: Specify the ROM to burn with --rom <file>.
op.no_cartridge: No cartridge detected; {cmd} aborted (empty write prevented). Insert a cartridge and retry.
op.rom_platform_mismatch: ROM/cartridge platform mismatch ({rom} ROM → {cart} cart): GBA ROMs can only be written to GBA cartridges, GB/GBC ROMs only to GB/GBC cartridges.
save.type_invalid: Invalid save type '{v}' (use eeprom4k / eeprom64k / sram / flash / fram).
profile.path_hint: External profile dir: {dir} (drop flashGBX fc_*.txt or custom .json here)
disconnect.ok: Disconnected (cartridge powered off, remembered port cleared).
voltage.auto: Voltage: auto (by cartridge: GBA=3.3V, MBC=3.3V; burn may briefly use 5V)
info.err_read: Could not read chip ID (check the cartridge is seated and the burner is OK).
info.no_cartridge: No cartridge detected (flash did not respond; check it is seated and powered).
rom_info.unrecognized: File is too small or the ROM format is unrecognized.
select.need_port_json: select cannot be interactive in --json mode; pass --port.
resolve.need_select: Multiple burners detected; run cfb select --port <port> first.
todo.with_port: {cmd} is not implemented yet (would use port {port}; protocol layer to be ported from C#).
todo.no_port: {cmd} is not implemented yet, and no burner is currently detected.
probe.title: Save chip probe
probe.health.unstable: unstable (repeated reads disagree; usually not seated)
probe.no_response: The save bus does not respond: the cartridge is not seated, or this cart has no save chip. Reseat it firmly before calling it dead.
probe.unstable: Repeated reads of the same address disagree = bus noise (bad contact). Write probes were skipped so nothing garbage lands in your save; reseat the cartridge and retry.
probe.readonly_skip: --no-write: read-only check only, no write commands issued, so the chip model and real capacity cannot be identified.
probe.flash_id: JEDEC ID {id} = {chip}, FLASH save of {n} bytes.
probe.flash_id_unknown: JEDEC ID {id} is valid but not in the known table: capacity unknown, pass --len explicitly.
probe.no_id: No JEDEC ID: not a FLASH save; continuing as SRAM/FRAM.
probe.not_writable: Write probe read back wrong: the save chip cannot be written (write-protected / absent / bad contact).
probe.bits_only_clear: Bits only go 1 -> 0 (writing 0xFF has no effect) = FLASH behaviour, not SRAM.
probe.wrap32: 0x8000 wraps to 0x0000: a single bank is only 32 KiB.
probe.mirrored: Bank switching has no effect: the high bank mirrors the low one, so there is really only one bank.
probe.banks: {n} independent bank(s) x {size} bytes = {total} bytes of actual capacity.
probe.declared: Cartridge header 0x149 declares a {n}-byte save (used only as a probe upper bound, not as the answer).
probe.declared_mismatch: Declared {declared} bytes, measured {actual} bytes: the measurement wins.
probe.mbc2: MBC2 has 512x4bit of on-chip save, no banks; capacity is fixed at 512 bytes.
probe.fram_hint: SRAM and FRAM behave identically for reads and writes and cannot be told apart online (they differ in retention and timing); pass --type fram if you know it is FRAM.
probe.restore_ok: All probe bytes were restored and verified by read-back.
probe.restore_fail: WARNING: failed to restore probe bytes; the on-cart save may be altered. Restore it from a backup now.
save.size_ambiguous: WARNING: capacity cannot be determined read-only (both banks happen to hold identical data); dumping 64 KiB for now. Run `cfb save-probe` to size it, or pass --len.
